office_does: San Juan County's one District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor cases for the whole county. Nonpartisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Carolyn Jewett-Platts, on the bench since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County District Court Judge since 2019 and a former deputy prosecutor; the only candidate.
highlights: Deputy prosecutor in San Juan County District Court 2015-2018 [S1]
Served on the District and Municipal Court Judges' Association board, 2022-2025 [S1]
